info.title: Badhan API
info.description:
Automatically generated documentation of Badhan API. Documentation is generated using TSOA
and initially created by Sumaiya Azad.

## How values are encoded

The API speaks **indices, not names**. A client that sends `"B+"` where a blood group belongs
gets a validation error; the value is `2`. The mappings below are the whole vocabulary, and the
individual fields below repeat them where they appear.

**Blood group** — `0` A+, `1` A-, `2` B+, `3` B-, `4` O+, `5` O-, `6` AB+, `7` AB-.
`-1` is a search-only sentinel meaning *any blood group*; no stored record holds it.
Public contacts accept Rh-positive groups only (`0`, `2`, `4`, `6`).

**Hall** — `0` Ahsan Ullah, `1` Sabekun Nahar Sony, `2` Kazi Nazrul Islam, `3` Dr. M. A. Rashid,
`4` Sher-E-Bangla, `5` Suhrawardy, `6` Titumir, `7` Attached, `8` (Unknown).
A donor record may hold any of these **except `7` Attached**. `8` means the hall was never
recorded, and `-1` is a search and report-drill-down sentinel meaning *any hall*.
Halls `0`-`6` are the residence halls a hall admin is scoped to; `7` and `8` belong to nobody,
so no hall admin can act on those records.

**Designation** (role) — `0` Donor, `1` Volunteer, `2` Hall Admin, `3` Super Admin.

**Dates** are Unix timestamps in **milliseconds**, sent and returned as numbers. Never ISO
strings. `0` is used for "never" on fields such as `lastDonation`.

**Student ID** is a 7-digit string, not a number, and it is structured: `1905005` is batch
`19` (admission year 2019), department `05`, roll `005`. The batch must be between `01` and the
current year's last two digits. Department codes are `01` Arch, `02` Ch.E, `04` CE, `05` CSE,
`06` EEE, `08` IPE, `10` ME, `11` MME, `12` NAME, `15` URP, `16` WRE, `17` NCE, `18` BME —
plus `00`, which names no department and is accepted only because older records carry it.
Codes not in that list are rejected.

## Response envelope

Every JSON response carries `status` (`"OK"` or `"ERROR"`), `statusCode` and `message`, with
the payload alongside on success. Check `status`, not only the HTTP status code.

servers.description: Production server — real donor data; every request here is live

phone.description: Bangladeshi number as a 13-digit integer including the country code, e.g. 8801521438557 — a number, not a string.

studentId.description: Seven digits as a string, structured as batch + department + roll: 1905005 is batch 19 (2019), department 05 (CSE), roll 005. Department must be one of 00, 01, 02, 04, 05, 06, 08, 10, 11, 12, 15, 16, 17, 18; batch must fall between 01 and the current year.

bloodGroup.description: Blood group index: 0 A+, 1 A-, 2 B+, 3 B-, 4 O+, 5 O-, 6 AB+, 7 AB-. Search endpoints also accept -1, meaning any.

hall.description: Hall index: 0 Ahsan Ullah, 1 Sabekun Nahar Sony, 2 Kazi Nazrul Islam, 3 Dr. M. A. Rashid, 4 Sher-E-Bangla, 5 Suhrawardy, 6 Titumir, 7 Attached, 8 (Unknown). A donor record may hold any of these except 7 (Attached). Search and report drill-down also accept -1, meaning any.

designation.description: Role index: 0 Donor, 1 Volunteer, 2 Hall Admin, 3 Super Admin.

commentTime.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds, not an ISO string. 0 when no comment has been written.

lastDonation.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds, not an ISO string. 0 when the donor has never donated.

lastPlateletDonation.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds, not an ISO string. 0 when the donor has never donated platelets.

expireAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds, not an ISO string. Absent on a session token that does not expire.

date.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds, not an ISO string.
